children: Texas Community Bancshares agreed to acquire The Banc of San Jacinto County Bancshares in an all-cash transaction valued at $9.5 million, subject to certain permitted tax distributions. The target will merge into Texas Community Bancshares, and its bank subsidiary will merge into Broadstreet Bank. Closing depends on shareholder and regulatory approvals and other customary conditions.
